title: Experts disagree on new done ladder
context:
Chief architect: Ruling: both claims describe the same ladder the owner already named. The QA claim adds one test per rung plus the step-back cases (CI red after PR open, an edit after Done marks it stale), matching EX-data-modeler-2. Accept as recommended.

Target: new done ladder
- product-owner: one ladder Done, Committed, PR open, Safe to merge, Merged replaces the four separate headline rows; each delivery event (commit, push, PR, CI result, merge) moves the change up a rung without waiting for the next turn end
- qa-engineer: one acceptance per rung, each as an integration test fed recorded delivery events: checks green with uncommitted edit shows Done; commit shows Committed; PR open shows PR open; CI green shows Safe to merge; merge shows Merged; plus negative cases CI red after PR open drops back and a later edit after Done marks the verdict stale rather than keeping Done
